observations: Photo 0 shows a beige and grey sewing machine with a red and white patterned fabric under the needle.
Photo 1 shows the same machine from a different angle, with a hand visible on the side and a power cord.
The machine has a circular dial on the front and a bobbin winder on the right.
There is a watermark 'SHARON TAYLOR' and 'POSTED ON Jiji' across both images.
No brand name or model number is legible on the machine in either photo.

claims.evidence: Photos show the machine is clean and in good cosmetic condition, but cannot confirm mechanical age or usage.
No usage history or proof of low mileage is provided.
Requires a video of the machine sewing to confirm it is functional.

risks.risk: The machine may not sew or may have mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing through fabric.

risks.risk: The motor may be weak, noisy, or burnt.
risks.proof: A video of the motor running at full speed.

risks.risk: The machine may be a generic brand with no brand name visible.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand name and model number on the machine.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate it works.
Video of the motor running to check for noise or overheating.
Photo of the underside of the machine to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
